name: block-editor
title: Block Editor
description: Notion-style document editor built on ProseKit: the Standard Toolbar (block type, history, text formats, list indent, insert table and divider), a / command menu, a format menu with a link field over selections, drag handles to reorder blocks, task and toggle lists, tables with row and column menus, code blocks, and Markdown shortcuts. onChange gives JSON, HTML and plain text.
